overall.assessment: Prema navedenoj strukturi, podcast je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkom antropologijom jer AI promatra kroz dostojanstvo radnika, smisao ljudskog rada, supsidijarnost i pitanje tko snosi koristi i troškove tehnoloških promjena; to odgovara crkvenom zahtjevu da tehnologija služi osobi, a ne obratno. Posebno je vrijedno što teme obuhvaćaju radnike na terenu, pravedno otpuštanje, vlasništvo nad zdravstvenim podacima i mogućnost da automatizacija donese više vremena za čovjeka, a ne samo veću produktivnost. Ipak, bez transkripta nije moguće prosuditi jesu li predložena rješenja, poput „suverenog AI-ja” u kućanstvu ili primjera iz drugih zemalja, predstavljena kritički i u službi općega dobra ili kao tehnološki recepti sami po sebi. Ocjena zato prepoznaje snažan potencijal za kršćansku refleksiju, uz potrebu da se ljudska vrijednost ne svede niti na ekonomsku korisnost niti na ulogu „posljednjeg čovjeka” koji nadzire strojeve.
seeds_of_logos: Razmatranje dostojanstva radnika i posljedica automatizacije prepoznaje da ljudska vrijednost ne ovisi o tržišnoj produktivnosti te da AI treba pomagati, a ne zamijeniti ljudsko prosuđivanje.
Teme pravednog otpuštanja, zapošljavanja i radnika koji grade infrastrukturu otvaraju prostor za solidarnost s ljudima čiji je rad često zanemaren u digitalnom gospodarstvu.

Pitanja supsidijarnosti, lokalnog odlučivanja i koncentracije moći mogu usmjeriti raspravu prema tehnologiji koja promiče sudjelovanje i opće dobro, umjesto da bogatstvo i odlučivanje gomila u rukama nekolicine.
Razmatranje slobodnog vremena, zdravstvenih podataka i AI-ja u svakodnevnom životu može potaknuti odgovorno upravljanje stvorenim svijetom i zaštitu osobnih odnosa i ljudske slobode.
concerns: Moguće je tehnološko rješenje prikazati kao dostatno samo po sebi: decentralizirani ili „suvereni” AI ne jamči pravednost ako nisu razmotreni njegovi ciljevi, posljedice i utjecaj na opće dobro.

Teme kamera, slušalica i zdravstvenih podataka nose rizik da se nadzor i privatnost tretiraju prvenstveno kao tehničko pitanje, a ne kao pitanje dostojanstva, slobode i odgovornosti prema osobi; iz samog popisa tema nije jasno kako su razriješene.

Izraz „posljednja ljudska uloga” može nenamjerno svesti čovjeka na nadzornika automatiziranog sustava, dok kršćanski pogled osobu razumije šire: kao biće sposobno za slobodan izbor, ljubav, odnose i sudjelovanje u stvaranju.
overall.theological_context: Mjerilo za procjenu pruža Antiqua et Nova (2025): umjetna inteligencija treba služiti ljudskom prosuđivanju, dostojanstvu radnika i općem dobru, a odgovornost za njezinu uporabu pripada svim razinama društva prema načelu supsidijarnosti. Pastoralna konstitucija Gaudium et Spes, kako je navedena u tom dokumentu, podupire shvaćanje ljudskog rada i tehničkog razvoja unutar cjelovitog dobra osobe; biblijski okvir uključuje čovjeka stvorenog na sliku Božju i pozvanog obrađivati i čuvati zemlju (Post 1–2).

overall.assessment_en: According to the provided structure, the podcast is mostly aligned with Catholic anthropology because it views AI through the dignity of the worker, the meaning of human work, subsidiarity, and the question of who bears the benefits and costs of technological changes; this corresponds to the Church's requirement that technology serve the person, and not vice versa. It is especially valuable that the topics encompass workers in the field, just dismissal, ownership over health data, and the possibility that automation might bring more time for the human person, and not merely greater productivity. Nevertheless, without a transcript it is not possible to judge whether the proposed solutions, such as "sovereign AI" in the household or examples from other countries, are presented critically and in the service of the common good, or as technological recipes in themselves. The assessment therefore recognizes a strong potential for Christian reflection, along with the need not to reduce human worth either to economic utility or to the role of the "last human" who oversees machines.
overall.theological_context_en: The benchmark for evaluation is provided by Antiqua et Nova (2025): artificial intelligence should serve human judgment, the dignity of workers, and the common good, while responsibility for its use belongs to all levels of society according to the principle of subsidiarity. The Pastoral Constitution Gaudium et Spes, as cited in that document, supports the understanding of human work and technical development within the integral good of the person; the biblical framework includes man created in the image of God and called to cultivate and care for the earth (Gen 1–2).
seeds_of_logos_en: The consideration of the dignity of workers and the consequences of automation recognizes that human worth does not depend on market productivity and that AI should assist, rather than replace, human judgment.
The topics of just dismissal, employment, and the workers who build infrastructure open space for solidarity with people whose labor is often neglected in the digital economy.

The questions of subsidiarity, local decision-making, and the concentration of power can direct the discussion toward technology that promotes participation and the common good, instead of accumulating wealth and decision-making in the hands of a few.
The consideration of leisure time, health data, and AI in everyday life can encourage responsible stewardship of the created world and the protection of personal relationships and human freedom.
concerns_en: It is possible to present a technological solution as sufficient in itself: decentralized or "sovereign" AI does not guarantee justice if its goals, consequences, and impact on the common good are not considered.

The topics of cameras, earphones, and health data carry the risk that surveillance and privacy are treated primarily as a technical question, rather than as a question of dignity, freedom, and responsibility toward the person; from the list of topics alone, it is not clear how they are resolved.

The phrase "the final human role" can unintentionally reduce the human person to a supervisor of an automated system, whereas the Christian view understands the person more broadly: as a being capable of free choice, love, relationships, and participation in creation.

sections.subtitle: Panel na Ascent Summitu: koja je posljednja ljudska uloga?
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Louis Kim otvara emisiju u podcast kabini na Ascent Summitu i predstavlja sugovornike
sections.content:
Epizoda podcasta **The Catholic Futurist** snimljena je uživo na **Ascent Summitu**, u podcast kabini FIO-a. Voditelj **Louis Kim** okupio je trojicu sugovornika koji umjetnu inteligenciju promatraju iz vrlo različitih kutova. **Matthew Harvey Sanders** svakodnevno radi s AI agentima svih velikih laboratorija. **Taylor Black** djeluje istodobno u velikoj tehnološkoj kompaniji i u katoličkom svijetu. **Vincent Higgins** vodi industrijsku tvrtku koja AI donosi radnicima na terenu.

Već uvodni isječci najavljuju ton razgovora. Sanders otvara etičku dilemu koja će se provlačiti kroz cijelu raspravu: smije li poslodavac zaposliti čovjeka da kontrolira rad AI modela ako zna da će ga za četiri mjeseca, kada izađe novi i znatno bolji model, morati otpustiti? Higgins upozorava da se u razvoju softvera više ne traži netko tko piše kod, nego netko tko „dirigira orkestrom”. Black citira Kevina Scotta, koji voli reći da su mnoge teške stvari postale trivijalne, i postavlja protupitanje: koje su nemoguće stvari postale tek teške?

Kim zatim postavlja pitanje koje će zaokružiti cijelu emisiju: **koja je posljednja ljudska uloga?**

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je opisni i ne iznosi tvrdnju koja bi bila u sukobu s katoličkim naukom. Samo predstavljanje različitih perspektiva na umjetnu inteligenciju ne potvrđuje niti prosuđuje njihove stavove.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička Crkva potiče znanstveni i tehnološki napredak, ali naglašava da tehnologija treba služiti ljudskoj osobi i općem dobru. U ovom odlomku nema dovoljno sadržaja da bi se procijenilo hoće li sudionici takav kriterij primijeniti na AI.

sections.subtitle_en: Panel at the Ascent Summit: what is the last human role?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Louis Kim opens the show in the podcast booth at the Ascent Summit and introduces the interlocutors
sections.content_en:
The episode of the podcast **The Catholic Futurist** was recorded live at the **Ascent Summit**, in the FIO podcast booth. Host **Louis Kim** gathered three interlocutors who view artificial intelligence from very different angles. **Matthew Harvey Sanders** works daily with AI agents from all major laboratories. **Taylor Black** operates simultaneously in a large tech company and in the Catholic world. **Vincent Higgins** leads an industrial company that brings AI to field workers.

Already the introductory clips announce the tone of the conversation. Sanders opens an ethical dilemma that will run through the entire discussion: is an employer permitted to hire a person to control the work of an AI model if he knows that in four months, when a new and significantly better model comes out, he will have to lay him off? Higgins warns that in software development one is no longer looking for someone who writes code, but someone who "conducts the orchestra". Black quotes Kevin Scott, who likes to say that many hard things have become trivial, and poses a counter-question: which impossible things have become merely hard?

Kim then poses the question that will round out the entire show: **what is the last human role?**

sections.subtitle: Samo 20 posto Amerikanaca s optimizmom gleda na AI
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders govori o podatku da je samo petina Amerikanaca optimistična prema AI-ju
sections.content:
Na voditeljevo pitanje što ih je u usvajanju umjetne inteligencije iznenadilo, bilo brzinom bilo sporošću, prvi odgovara **Matthew Harvey Sanders**. Brzina usvajanja na razini velikih poduzeća njega ne čudi. Tvrtke uspoređuje s prekooceanskim brodovima kojima treba vremena da promijene smjer, no smatra da sve redom shvaćaju kako je riječ o pitanju opstanka.

Iznenadilo ga je nešto drugo: koliko je uspješna, kako je naziva, **propaganda** koja je prosječne ljude uvjerila da je AI prijetnja njihovoj budućnosti kojoj se treba oduprijeti. Dio javnosti, kaže, odbija koristiti tehnologiju u uvjerenju da time usmjerava čovječanstvo u boljem smjeru. Navodi i nedavno objavljen podatak, uz napomenu da se takve brojke mijenjaju iz tjedna u tjedan: **samo 20 posto Amerikanaca optimistično gleda na smjer razvoja umjetne inteligencije.**

Sanders priznaje i vlastitu odgovornost. Ljudi iz industrije, kaže, loše su objasnili koliko tehnologija može pomoći u borbi protiv najvećih nevolja ljudskog postojanja, poput **bolesti i neznanja**. Upozorava i na geopolitičku dimenziju: **Kina će nastaviti usvajati AI**. Ako Zapad tehnologiju odbija iz straha za vlastitu budućnost, a istodobno se boji svijeta u kojem Kina dominira umjetnom inteligencijom, to će za Zapad postati egzistencijalni problem.

magisterium.assessment: Opis javnog straha i sugovornikovo iznenađenje zbog njega sami po sebi nisu protivni katoličkom nauku, jer su izneseni kao opažanje, a ne kao zaključak da su zabrinutosti neutemeljene. Navedeni podatak o 20 % nije moguće provjeriti na temelju dostupnih izvora.
concerns: Izraz da je raširen strah „iznenađujući” mogao bi umanjiti opravdane etičke brige ako bi se kasnije prikazale kao nerazumne bez razmatranja njihovih razloga.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički pristup AI-ju nije ni bezuvjetni optimizam ni opće odbacivanje: tehnologija može donijeti koristi, ali mogućnost štete traži razlučivanje. Zabrinutost zbog zamjene ljudskog rada i narušavanja ljudskog dostojanstva ima stvarnu težinu; Crkva traži da AI podupire, a ne zamjenjuje ljudsko prosuđivanje i rad.

sections.subtitle_en: Only 20 percent of Americans view AI with optimism
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders talks about the data that only a fifth of Americans are optimistic toward AI
sections.content_en:
To the host's question about what surprised them in the adoption of artificial intelligence, whether by its speed or slowness, **Matthew Harvey Sanders** is the first to answer. The speed of adoption at the level of large enterprises does not surprise him. He compares companies to ocean liners that take time to change direction, but he believes that all of them realize that it is a matter of survival.

Something else surprised him: how successful, as he calls it, the **propaganda** has been that convinced average people that AI is a threat to their future that should be resisted. Part of the public, he says, refuses to use the technology in the belief that they are thereby steering humanity in a better direction. He also cites recently published data, noting that such figures change from week to week: **only 20 percent of Americans view the direction of artificial intelligence development with optimism.**

Sanders also admits his own responsibility. People from the industry, he says, did a poor job explaining how much technology can help in the fight against the greatest afflictions of human existence, such as **disease and ignorance**. He also warns of the geopolitical dimension: **China will continue to adopt AI**. If the West rejects technology out of fear for its own future, and at the same time fears a world in which China dominates artificial intelligence, that will become an existential problem for the West.

sections.subtitle: AI razotkriva što mislimo o čovjeku
sections.screenshot_description: Taylor Black objašnjava da AI na vidjelo izvlači pretpostavke o tome što znači biti čovjek
sections.content:
Louis Kim zatim se obraća **Tayloru Blacku**, koji jednom nogom stoji u velikoj tehnološkoj kompaniji, a drugom u katoličkom svijetu. Black izdvaja dva zapažanja.

Prvo, AI je **tehnologija koju je teško dobro usvojiti**. Jednostavne primjene su lake. Svatko ga je, kaže, upotrijebio za neku zabavnu sitnicu, primjerice za igru riječi za bratovo vjenčanje. Sam ga je dan ranije koristio da izradi prikaz **svetog Ivana Zlatoustog s kriglom piva** za župni domjenak. Mnogo je zahtjevnije AI uklopiti u stvarne radne procese tako da i dalje dobro surađujete s drugim ljudima i da ne prepustite stroju kognitivne sposobnosti koje će vam kasnije trebati. Zato je usvajanje, kaže, vrlo neujednačeno, kako kod pojedinaca tako i u malim, srednjim i velikim tvrtkama.

Velika poduzeća imaju prednost jer su im podaci, procesi i poslovanje već strogo uređeni, pa AI uglavnom uvode u okruženju usklađenom s propisima. Za velik broj malih i srednjih poduzeća to ne vrijedi.

Drugo zapažanje je filozofsko. Usvajanje AI-ja **na vidjelo izvlači pretpostavke ljudi o tome što znači biti čovjek**. Rasprava o tome je li AI čovjek, smatra Black, srećom je završena, jer su to posve različite stvari. No onaj tko ima **siromašnu antropologiju** doista će zaključiti da AI može raditi sve što radi čovjek, ako misli da se čovjek svodi upravo na te radnje. Upravo zato, kaže, nova tehnologija otvara zanimljive razgovore do kojih inače ne bi došlo.

magisterium.assessment: Uglavnom je usklađeno: način na koji se AI uvodi može otkriti shvaćamo li čovjeka cjelovito ili ga svodimo na učinkovitost i mjerljive kognitivne funkcije; upozorenje na kognitivno rasterećenje zato je relevantno ako se njime ne sugerira da je svaka uporaba AI-ja štetna. Dostavljeni izvori ne potvrđuju konkretno pozivanje na sv. Ivana Zlatoustog, pa tu atribuciju nije moguće ocijeniti.
concerns: Nije jasno znači li kognitivno rasterećenje razboritu pomoć ljudskom prosuđivanju ili njegovo potiskivanje.
Nije potvrđeno što je sv. Ivan Zlatousti rekao u ovom kontekstu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko razumijevanje čovjeka polazi od jedinstva tijela i duše, pa ljudsku inteligenciju i rad ne treba svesti na funkcije koje se mogu automatizirati ili izmjeriti. AI valja koristiti kao pomoć ljudskoj inteligenciji, ne kao njezinu zamjenu, uz očuvanje onih ljudskih sposobnosti i dimenzija života koje nadilaze računanje.

concerns_en: It is not clear whether cognitive offloading means prudent assistance to human judgment or its suppression.
It is not confirmed what St. John Chrysostom said in this context.

sections.subtitle_en: AI reveals what we think about man
sections.screenshot_description_en: Taylor Black explains that AI brings to light assumptions about what it means to be human
sections.content_en:
Louis Kim then turns to **Taylor Black**, who stands with one foot in a large tech company and the other in the Catholic world. Black singles out two observations.

First, AI is a **technology that is difficult to adopt well**. Simple applications are easy. Everyone, he says, has used it for some fun little thing, for example for a pun for a brother's wedding. He himself used it the day before to create a depiction of **Saint John Chrysostom with a mug of beer** for a parish reception. It is much more demanding to integrate AI into actual work processes so that you still cooperate well with other people and do not surrender to the machine cognitive abilities that you will need later. That is why adoption, he says, is very uneven, both among individuals and in small, medium, and large companies.

Large enterprises have an advantage because their data, processes, and operations are already strictly regulated, so they mostly introduce AI in an environment aligned with regulations. For a large number of small and medium-sized enterprises, this is not the case.

The second observation is philosophical. The adoption of AI **brings to light people's assumptions about what it means to be human**. The debate over whether AI is human, Black believes, is fortunately over, because those are completely different things. But whoever has a **poor anthropology** will indeed conclude that AI can do everything a human does, if they think that man is reduced precisely to those actions. That is precisely why, he says, the new technology opens up interesting conversations that would otherwise not happen.

sections.subtitle: Procesni dug i oprez radnika s ključem u ruci
sections.screenshot_description: Vincent Higgins objašnjava kako industrijski radnici na terenu provjeravaju svaki odgovor AI-ja
sections.content:
Voditelj zatim prenosi razgovor s partnerima konzultantske kuće **Bain**. Oni su mu rekli da je usvajanje sporije od očekivanog jer se zaboravlja koliko ljudskog rada postoji izvan ekrana, tipkovnice i miša. U organizacijama se nakupio **procesni dug**. Kim to ilustrira njihovom usporedbom: ako gradska vozila hitne pomoći zamijenite Ferrarijima, neće zbog toga brže prolaziti kroz semafore i zavoje.

Pitanje upućuje **Vincentu Higginsu**, direktoru industrijske tvrtke koja nije čisto AI kompanija, ali koristi umjetnu inteligenciju. Higgins objašnjava da njihov sustav donosi AI **industrijskom radniku na terenu**: radnik u mobilnom uređaju može razgovarati s AI-jem i dobiti uputu kako popraviti pumpu ili kako glasi sigurnosna procedura.

Tu, kaže, leži problem. **Ako AI odgovori pogrešno, posljedice mogu biti teške.** Zato je usvajanje sporije od očekivanog: na početku korisnici prate svako pitanje i svaki odgovor, a povjerenje grade postupno, kako vide učinke na terenu. Higgins naglašava da AI **nikada neće zamijeniti radnika s ključem u ruci**. Može mu pomoći, povećati sigurnost, poboljšati poslovanje i pouzdanost. Proces traje dulje jer inženjerski način razmišljanja traži kontrolu nad ishodima.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je snažno usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer uzima ozbiljno rad izvan digitalnog sučelja te potrebu radnika za sigurnošću i povjerenjem pri uvođenju tehnologije. Posebno je primjeren naglasak na sigurnosti zaposlenja, dostojanstvu radnika i uključivanju ljudske prosudbe, a ne samo na brzini usvajanja AI-ja.
concerns: Bilo bi važno da se oprez radnika ne prikazuje kao puka prepreka napretku, nego kao opravdan zahtjev za sudjelovanjem, osposobljavanjem i zaštitom dostojanstvenog rada.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk uči da je rad više od sredstva zarade: može biti put osobnog razvoja, izgradnje odnosa i zajedničke odgovornosti. Zato tehnološki napredak treba podupirati ljudski rad, štititi sigurnost zaposlenja i pravedne uvjete te uključiti provjerljive mjere za osposobljavanje i sudjelovanje radnika.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is strongly aligned with Catholic teaching because it takes seriously work outside the digital interface and the worker's need for safety and trust when introducing technology. Particularly commendable is the emphasis on job security, the dignity of the worker, and the inclusion of human judgment, rather than merely on the speed of AI adoption.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching teaches that work is more than a means of earning a living: it can be a path of personal development, building relationships, and shared responsibility. Therefore, technological progress should support human work, protect job security and just conditions, and include verifiable measures for worker training and participation.
concerns_en: It would be important that worker caution is not portrayed as a mere obstacle to progress, but as a justified demand for participation, training, and the protection of dignified work.

sections.subtitle_en: Process debt and the caution of the worker with a wrench in hand
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vincent Higgins explains how industrial workers in the field verify every AI response
sections.content_en:
The host then recounts a conversation with partners from the consulting firm **Bain**. They told him that adoption is slower than expected because it is forgotten how much human labor exists beyond the screen, keyboard, and mouse. In organizations, **process debt** has accumulated. Kim illustrates this with their comparison: if you replace city ambulances with Ferraris, they will not pass through traffic lights and turns any faster because of it.

He directs the question to **Vincent Higgins**, the director of an industrial company that is not a purely AI company, but uses artificial intelligence. Higgins explains that their system brings AI to the **industrial worker in the field**: on a mobile device, the worker can talk to the AI and receive instructions on how to repair a pump or what the safety procedure is.

Here, he says, lies the problem. **If the AI answers incorrectly, the consequences can be severe.** That is why adoption is slower than expected: at the beginning, users monitor every question and every answer, and build trust gradually, as they see the effects in the field. Higgins emphasizes that AI **will never replace the worker with a wrench in hand**. It can help him, increase safety, improve operations and reliability. The process takes longer because the engineering mindset seeks control over outcomes.

sections.subtitle: Kontrola kvalitete i dilema: zaposliti nekoga na četiri mjeseca?
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders opisuje etičku dilemu zapošljavanja ljudi za kontrolu rada AI modela
sections.content:
Kim prenosi još jedno zapažanje iz Baina. Generativni AI nije deterministički, čak ni AI inženjeri ne razumiju sasvim što se događa unutar te crne kutije, pa je dio ušteđenog rada pojela **kontrola kvalitete (QA/QC)**. Čovjek i dalje mora biti uključen u proces. Kim zato pita kako se promijenio profil ljudi koje tvrtke zapošljavaju, primjerice na mjestima direktora informatike ili IT menadžera.

**Matthew Harvey Sanders** slaže se da je kontrola kvalitete trenutačno nužna, ali upozorava da se stvari mijenjaju iznimno brzo. Kao prijelomnu točku navodi studeni, kada je izašao model **Opus 4.5**. Taj datum smatra početkom doba AI-ja i robotike. Za zaposlenje u **Anthropicu**, objašnjava, treba položiti iznimno težak dvosatni test, a Opus 4.5 bio je prvi model koji ga je riješio bolje od ikojeg čovjeka u povijesti tvrtke.

Sanders priznaje da je programiranje specifično područje u koje se ulaže mnogo truda, ali vidi da se modeli počinju **generalizirati**. Model Astra opisuje kao „uznemirujuće općenit”, iako ga ne bi nazvao AGI-jem kao Jensen. Svako novo izdanje, kaže, u nečemu je bolje, a on sam sve manje vremena troši na kontrolu kvalitete.

To izravno utječe na zapošljavanje. Ako zaposli nekoga da provjerava rad modela, a za četiri mjeseca nova generacija bude, kako kaže, ne deset, ali možda pet puta bolja, što onda s tom osobom? **Je li ispravno zaposliti nekoga ako unaprijed zna da će ga za četiri mjeseca otpustiti?** Možda je bolje, razmišlja, da se sam nekako probije kroz posao, jer to ne želi učiniti ljudskoj osobi. Priznaje da je čudno svakodnevno se hrvati s takvim pitanjima.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da generativni AI treba nadzirati i da čovjek ostane uključen uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim načelom da AI treba pomagati, a ne zamjenjivati ljudsko prosuđivanje. Tehnička tvrdnja o nedeterminističnosti i pitanje zapošljavanja na četiri mjeseca sami po sebi ne određuju moralni sud; važno je uzeti u obzir sigurnost zaposlenja, dostojanstvo radnika i način na koji se koristi od automatizacije raspodjeljuju.
concerns: Prikaz kontrole kvalitete kao izgubljenog dijela uštede rada može biti nepotpun: ljudski nadzor ima i vrijednost u zaštiti od pogrešaka i očuvanju odgovornog odlučivanja. Odluka o kratkoročnom zapošljavanju treba procijeniti posljedice za radnika, a ne samo poslovnu učinkovitost.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk ne odbacuje tehnološki napredak, nego traži da služi ljudima i zajedničkom dobru. Papa Lav XIV. poziva da uvođenje automatizacije prate provjerljive mjere za zaštitu zaposlenja, prekvalifikaciju i sudjelovanje radnika, pa ljudski nadzor treba promatrati i kao dio odgovorne organizacije rada.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that generative AI should be monitored and that a human should remain involved is largely in alignment with the Catholic principle that AI should assist, not replace, human judgment. The technical claim about non-determinism and the question of hiring for four months do not in themselves determine a moral judgment; it is important to take into account job security, the dignity of workers, and the way the benefits of automation are distributed.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching does not reject technological progress, but demands that it serve people and the common good. Pope Leo XIV calls for the introduction of automation to be accompanied by verifiable measures to protect employment, retraining, and worker participation, so human oversight should also be viewed as part of the responsible organization of work.
concerns_en: The presentation of quality control as a lost part of labor savings may be incomplete: human oversight also has value in protecting against errors and preserving responsible decision-making. The decision on short-term hiring should evaluate the consequences for the worker, not just business efficiency.

sections.subtitle_en: Quality control and the dilemma: hire someone for four months?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders describes the ethical dilemma of hiring people to oversee the work of AI models
sections.content_en:
Kim conveys another observation from Bain. Generative AI is not deterministic, not even AI engineers fully understand what is happening inside that black box, so part of the saved labor has been eaten up by **quality control (QA/QC)**. A human still has to be involved in the process. Kim therefore asks how the profile of people companies hire has changed, for example in positions of IT directors or IT managers.

**Matthew Harvey Sanders** agrees that quality control is currently necessary, but warns that things are changing extremely fast. As a turning point, he cites November, when the **Opus 4.5** model was released. He considers that date the beginning of the era of AI and robotics. For employment at **Anthropic**, he explains, one must pass an extremely difficult two-hour test, and Opus 4.5 was the first model that solved it better than any human in the company's history.

Sanders acknowledges that programming is a specific field into which a lot of effort is invested, but he sees that models are beginning to **generalize**. He describes the Astra model as "disturbingly general", although he would not call it AGI like Jensen. Every new release, he says, is better at something, and he himself spends less and less time on quality control.

This directly affects hiring. If he hires someone to check the model's work, and in four months the new generation is, as he says, not ten, but maybe five times better, what then with that person? **Is it right to hire someone if he knows in advance that he will lay them off in four months?** Maybe it is better, he reflects, to somehow push through the work himself, because he does not want to do that to a human person. He admits that it is strange to grapple with such questions on a daily basis.

sections.subtitle: Plavi ovratnici grade infrastrukturu, a politika šuti
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders upozorava na zamrznuto zapošljavanje bijelih ovratnika i manjak političke rasprave
sections.content:
Sanders zatim širi perspektivu na tržište rada. Trenutačno se, kaže, čuje da AI ne remeti bitno tržište rada i da se zapošljava više. No pomniji pogled na statistiku pokazuje da se zapošljavaju uglavnom **plavi ovratnici koji grade AI infrastrukturu**, dok je zapošljavanje **bijelih ovratnika praktički zamrznuto**.

Ako se trend nastavi, modeli će postati vrhunski u uredskim poslovima. Kada **utjelovljeni AI i roboti** postanu dovoljno sposobni, Sanders pita, zar se isto neće dogoditi i plavim ovratnicima? Svatko tko danas razmišlja o zapošljavanju, smatra, mora to uzeti u obzir.

Vjeruje da će to postati sve veći problem za američku administraciju. Kako će ljudima jamčiti da će imati posao? I ako ga neće imati, kako će im jamčiti da neće izgubiti domove? Najviše ga brine **koliko se malo o tome razgovara** izvan kruga nekolicine šefova AI laboratorija. Nema ozbiljnih rasprava o javnim politikama, a političari gotovo šute.

Posljedica je, upozorava, da ljudi, svjesni da bi tehnologija mogla imati negativan učinak, umjesto o rješenjima i o tome kako zajedno proći kroz razdoblje promjena počinju razmišljati iz **straha i ljutnje**. Boji se da bi se to s vremenom moglo nakupiti i prerasti u nagli izljev bijesa, što bi se moglo izbjeći kad bi se kao nacija otvoreno razgovaralo o tome kako proći kroz to razdoblje.

magisterium.assessment: Upozorenje da automatizacija može ugroziti radna mjesta i neravnomjerno raspodijeliti koristi u skladu je s katoličkom brigom za dostojanstvo rada i zaštitu zaposlenih. Međutim, tvrdnje da su uredska zapošljavanja praktički zamrznuta, da uglavnom rade fizički radnici na AI infrastrukturi te da politika o tome šuti nisu potkrijepljene raspoloživim izvorima, pa ih treba predstaviti kao provjerljive procjene, a ne kao utvrđene činjenice.
concerns: Moguće buduće ugrožavanje fizičkih poslova zbog utjelovljenog AI-ja izneseno je kao prognoza, a ne kao siguran ishod; dostupni izvori ne omogućuju procjenu njezine vjerojatnosti. Općenita formulacija o šutnji politike ne razlikuje moguće razlike među državama, sektorima i politikama.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko mjerilo nije očuvanje svakog postojećeg radnog mjesta pod svaku cijenu, nego usmjeravanje tehnologije tako da ljudima služi, umjesto da se ljudi podrede učinkovitosti. Crkveni nauk upozorava na rizik da zamjena radnika donese nerazmjernu korist nekolicini, a trošak prebaci na mnoge; zato su važni zaštita zaposlenja, dostupna prekvalifikacija i sudjelovanje radnika u promjenama.

magisterium.assessment_en: The warning that automation can jeopardize jobs and unevenly distribute benefits aligns with Catholic concern for the dignity of work and the protection of workers. However, the claims that office hiring is practically frozen, that mostly physical workers on AI infrastructure are working, and that politics is silent about it are not substantiated by available sources, so they should be presented as verifiable assessments rather than established facts.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic criterion is not the preservation of every existing job at all costs, but rather the directing of technology so that it serves people, instead of people being subordinated to efficiency. Church teaching warns of the risk that the replacement of workers might bring disproportionate benefit to a few, while shifting the cost onto many; therefore, employment protection, accessible retraining, and worker participation in changes are important.
concerns_en: The possible future endangerment of physical jobs due to embodied AI is presented as a forecast, not as a certain outcome; available sources do not allow for an assessment of its probability. The generalized formulation about the silence of politics does not distinguish possible differences among states, sectors, and policies.

sections.subtitle_en: Blue collars build infrastructure, while politics remains silent
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders warns of frozen white-collar hiring and the lack of political debate
sections.content_en:
Sanders then broadens the perspective to the labor market. Currently, he says, one hears that AI is not significantly disrupting the labor market and that more hiring is taking place. But a closer look at the statistics shows that it is mainly **blue-collar workers building AI infrastructure** who are being hired, while the hiring of **white collars is practically frozen**.

If the trend continues, the models will become superior in office jobs. When **embodied AI and robots** become capable enough, Sanders asks, will not the same thing happen to blue collars? Anyone thinking about employment today, he believes, must take this into account.

He believes that this will become an increasing problem for the American administration. How will they guarantee people that they will have a job? And if they will not have it, how will they guarantee them that they will not lose their homes? What worries him most is **how little this is talked about** outside the circle of a few AI lab heads. There are no serious discussions about public policies, and politicians are almost silent.

The consequence, he warns, is that people, aware that technology could have a negative impact, instead of thinking about solutions and about how to go through the period of change together, begin to think out of **fear and anger**. He fears that over time this could build up and escalate into a sudden outburst of rage, which could be avoided if there were an open discussion as a nation about how to go through that period.

sections.subtitle: Ne programer, nego dirigent orkestra
sections.screenshot_description: Vincent Higgins opisuje novi profil zaposlenika koji usmjerava AI agente
sections.content:
Louis Kim najavljuje da će se kasnije vratiti na katoličku temu supsidijarnosti i suverenog AI-ja, ali prvo pita **Vincenta Higginsa** kako se promijenio profil ljudi koje zapošljava.

Higgins odgovara da se na razvojnoj strani danas **zapošljava netko tko dirigira orkestrom, a ne netko tko piše kod**. To smatra samorazumljivim. Takva osoba mora biti više generalist i mora biti vrlo pametna da bi dobro koristila alate. Alati su dostupni svima, napominje, ali ih ne koriste svi učinkovito.

Kao primjer navodi vlastitog voditelja AI-ja, **veterana s 40 godina iskustva** u razvoju softvera. On danas zapravo orkestrira: pokreće AI agente i s malim timom obavlja posao velikog tima.

magisterium.assessment: Uglavnom je usklađeno: usmjeravanje AI alata uz ljudsku prosudbu odgovara crkvenom načelu da AI treba pomagati, a ne zamjenjivati ljudski sud. Izraz „vrlo pametni generalisti” opisuje poslovnu preferenciju, ali sam po sebi ne određuje moralnu vrijednost radnika.
concerns: Nije izričito rečeno da ljudi koji usmjeravaju AI ostaju odgovorni za njegove učinke niti kako se štite radnici čije poslove AI mijenja.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni dokument Antiqua et Nova naglašava da AI treba podupirati ljudski rad, a ne ga sve više zamjenjivati, te da se radnike ne smije svoditi na kotačiće u stroju. Ljudska prosudba i odgovorno usmjeravanje tehnologije važni su zato što njezina uporaba mora služiti ljudskom dostojanstvu i općem dobru.

magisterium.assessment_en: Mostly aligned: directing AI tools with human judgment corresponds to the Church principle that AI should assist, not replace, human judgment. The expression "very smart generalists" describes a business preference, but does not in itself determine the moral value of workers.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church document Antiqua et Nova emphasizes that AI should support human labor rather than increasingly replace it, and that workers must not be reduced to cogs in a machine. Human judgment and responsible guidance of technology are important because its use must serve human dignity and the common good.
concerns_en: It is not explicitly stated that the people who direct AI remain responsible for its effects, nor how workers whose jobs are altered by AI are protected.

sections.subtitle_en: Not a programmer, but an orchestra conductor
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vincent Higgins describes the new employee profile directing AI agents
sections.content_en:
Louis Kim announces that he will return later to the Catholic topic of subsidiarity and sovereign AI, but first asks **Vincent Higgins** how the profile of the people he hires has changed.

Higgins responds that on the development side today, **someone who conducts an orchestra is hired, not someone who writes code**. He considers this self-evident. Such a person must be more of a generalist and must be very smart to use the tools well. The tools are available to everyone, he notes, but not everyone uses them effectively.

As an example, he cites his own head of AI, a **veteran with 40 years of experience** in software development. Today, he actually orchestrates: he launches AI agents and, with a small team, does the work of a large team.

sections.subtitle: Otpuštanje dostojno čovjeka: što kaže katolički socijalni nauk
sections.screenshot_description: Taylor Black govori o odgovornosti poslodavca prema radniku u vrijeme otpuštanja
sections.content:
Kim se nadovezuje na Blackovu tvrdnju da je pitanje je li AI čovjek već pomalo izlizano. Njega je razdoblje AI-ja natjeralo da preispita i **odnose među ljudima**. Ako kritiziramo AI jer narušava odnos stroja i čovjeka, kaže, ni odnosi među ljudima nisu savršeni. Posebno se to vidi kod **otpuštanja**. AI će promijeniti sastav zaposlenih i donosit će se teške odluke. Zato pita sugovornike koliko su ponosni na to kako su dosad otpuštali ljude i koliko je to bilo u skladu s **katoličkim socijalnim naukom**.

**Taylor Black** navodi nekoliko okvira za otpuštanja bez krivnje radnika i za prijelazno razdoblje:

- **Zadržavanje nije uvijek usluga.** Ako nekoga držite na radnom mjestu koje neće imati vrijednost na tržištu, činite mu lošu uslugu. Poslodavac može biti zahvalan što je osoba bila dio tvrtke, ali ona mora misliti na vlastitu karijeru.
- **Očuvanje tržišne vrijednosti radnika** zadaća je svakog poslodavca: radnik treba moći ostati konkurentan, po mogućnosti u poslu koji voli, i prehraniti obitelj.
- **Prekvalifikacija i preusmjeravanje.** Tko ima resursa, može ponuditi prekvalifikaciju ili preusmjeriti vještine radnika prema područjima u kojima nastaje novi posao.

Black dodaje i misao koju je, kaže, Sanders već naznačio. AI nije koristan samo za uštede, nego i za **rješavanje novih vrsta problema koji ranije nisu bili isplativi**. Zato poslodavce potiče da otvore prostor za inovacije i zapitaju se koje su ideje svojedobno odložili jer nisu išle, a koje bi sada mogle postati dobra poslovna linija ili rješenje za novu vrstu kupaca. Takvi su pomaci teži jer ne slijede ustaljeni način rada. Zaključuje citatom Kevina Scotta: **mnoge teške stvari postale su trivijalne, a pitanje je koje su nemoguće stvari postale tek teške.**

magisterium.assessment: Promiče katolički socijalni nauk: ispravno povezuje promjene koje donosi AI s dostojanstvom radnika i zahtjevom da se odluke o otpuštanju donose s poštovanjem prema osobama. Važna je nijansa da tekst ne tvrdi kako je svako otpuštanje samo po sebi nedopušteno, nego usmjerava pozornost na ljudske i društvene posljedice takvih odluka.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk upozorava na rizik da AI zamijeni radnike radi koristi nekolicine, dok mnogi snose teret gubitka posla; ljudski život ima vrijednost neovisno o ekonomskoj produktivnosti. Poslodavci stoga trebaju prepoznati znanje i iskustvo radnika, a odluke o restrukturiranju usmjeravati prema dostojanstvu osobe, pravednosti i dobrobiti obitelji i zajednice.

magisterium.assessment_en: Promotes Catholic social teaching: correctly links the changes brought by AI with the dignity of workers and the requirement that decisions on layoffs be made with respect for persons. An important nuance is that the text does not claim that every layoff is impermissible in itself, but directs attention to the human and social consequences of such decisions.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching warns of the risk that AI will replace workers for the benefit of a few, while many bear the burden of job loss; human life has value independent of economic productivity. Employers should therefore recognize the knowledge and experience of workers, and direct restructuring decisions toward the dignity of the person, justice, and the well-being of the family and community.

sections.subtitle_en: Dismissal worthy of a human being: what Catholic social teaching says
sections.screenshot_description_en: Taylor Black speaks about the employer's responsibility toward the worker at the time of layoffs
sections.content_en:
Kim builds on Black's assertion that the question of whether AI is human is already somewhat worn out. The AI era made him reconsider **relationships among people** as well. If we criticize AI because it disrupts the relationship between machine and man, he says, relationships among people are not perfect either. This is especially seen in **layoffs**. AI will change the composition of employees and difficult decisions will be made. That is why he asks his interlocutors how proud they are of how they have laid off people so far and how much that was in accordance with **Catholic social teaching**.

**Taylor Black** cites several frameworks for no-fault layoffs of workers and for the transition period:

- **Retention is not always a favor.** If you keep someone in a job that will not have value on the market, you are doing them a disservice. An employer can be grateful that the person was part of the company, but that person must think about their own career.
- **Preserving the worker's market value** is the task of every employer: the worker should be able to remain competitive, preferably in a job they love, and provide for their family.
- **Retraining and redirection.** Whoever has the resources can offer retraining or redirect workers' skills toward areas where new work is emerging.

Black also adds a thought that, he says, Sanders had already indicated. AI is not only useful for savings, but also for **solving new kinds of problems that were previously not profitable**. Therefore, he encourages employers to open up space for innovations and ask themselves which ideas they once set aside because they didn't work, but which could now become a good line of business or a solution for a new type of customers. Such shifts are more difficult because they do not follow an established way of working. He concludes with a quote from Kevin Scott: **many hard things have become trivial, and the question is which impossible things have become merely hard.**

sections.subtitle: Suvereni AI u svakom kućanstvu kao odgovor na centralizaciju
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders govori o Papinom upozorenju na koncentraciju moći i ideji kućnog suverenog AI-ja
sections.content:
Kim najavljuje završni krug pitanja među sudionicima i u šali upozorava Sandersa da bi ga mogao prekinuti ako se previše raspriča. Zatim postavlja pitanje: kakav je katolički pogled na činjenicu da je AI, zbog golemog potrebnog kapitala, **centraliziran u nekoliko velikih kompanija**?

**Matthew Harvey Sanders** odgovara da je Papa dao prilično jasan smjer. Upozorio je da sadašnja centralizacija vodi **koncentraciji moći**, u kojoj nekolicina ljudi donosi odluke koje se tiču cijelog čovječanstva. Sanders to vidi kao egzistencijalnu prijetnju slobodi i ljudskom djelovanju. Papa je, smatra, otišao onoliko daleko koliko je mogao. Povijest pokazuje da to nije dobro, a najgore bi bilo prepustiti se struji kao da je sve neizbježno.

Zanimljivo je da ni sami šefovi laboratorija, prema njegovu uvjerenju, to ne žele. Morali su prikupiti toliko novca da su postali ovisni o ekonomskim interesima i, kako kaže, žele se osloboditi dioničara. Kao primjer navodi **Demisa Hassabisa** i druge koji traže regulaciju. Tvrdi da dioničari to sigurno ne traže, nego da šefovi laboratorija to osobno smatraju nužnim jer imaju djecu i brinu o svijetu u kojem će ona odrastati.

Sandersov odgovor je **suvereni AI na razini kućanstva**. Iznosi niz praktičnih koraka:

- **Dostupna računalna snaga.** Laboratoriji je otkupljuju godinama unaprijed. Uređaj **DGX Spark** tvrtke **Nvidia** trebao je, kaže, stajati oko 3.500 dolara, a sada je oko sedam tisuća i cijena raste.
- **Pritisak na izabrane dužnosnike**, kako bi znali da građanima nije svejedno mogu li sami pokretati AI. Ne bi svako pitanje, osobito osjetljivo, smjelo završiti u velikom laboratoriju. Ljudi bi trebali imati pravo na vlastitu računalnu snagu, modele i energiju za njih kod kuće.
- **Mali modeli su dovoljni.** Prosječan mali model danas, u odgovarajućem okruženju, može riješiti **90 do 95 posto** pitanja i zadataka. Zašto onda plaćati laboratorij, pita, ako se kod kuće plaća samo struja?
- **Konkretan prijedlog politici.** Vlast bi mogla od **Jensena Huanga** iz Nvidije zatražiti da **20 posto računalne snage prodaje potrošačima**, a ne sve velikim laboratorijima. Sanders vjeruje da bi Huang, koji je prema njegovim riječima upravo kupio Hugging Face i ulaže u Poolside, takvu viziju podržao. Ne bi to, međutim, mogao sam predložiti dioničarima.

Takav model AI-ja Sanders smatra izrazito usklađenim s **načelom supsidijarnosti** i učenjem Crkve, kao način da se odupre centralizaciji.

magisterium.assessment: Kritika koncentracije AI-ja u nekoliko kompanija dobro se uklapa u katolički nauk: crkveni dokumenti upozoravaju na monopole, nejednakost i koncentraciju ekonomskog i političkog utjecaja. Prijedlog da svako kućanstvo ima vlastiti „suvereni” AI može biti jedan mogući odgovor, ali nije sam po sebi propisani katolički zahtjev niti je dostatno rješenje za šire probleme pristupa, odgovornosti i zajedničkog dobra.
concerns: Tvrdnja da Papa upozorava na koncentraciju moći i bogatstva općenito je potkrijepljena, ali izvori govore o širem problemu monopolizacije i nejednake raspodjele utjecaja, a ne nužno o točno toj formulaciji.
Lokalni AI u svakom kućanstvu predstavljen je kao prijedlog, ne kao izričit crkveni nauk; sam po sebi ne jamči pravedan pristup ni odgovornu uporabu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko načelo supsidijarnosti traži da zajednice mogu sudjelovati u odlukama i ispravljati ih, umjesto da samo naknadno nadziru standarde koje su drugi već odredili. To načelo podupire decentralizaciju ondje gdje ona jača ljudsku sposobnost djelovanja, ali crkveni nauk naglašava i univerzalni pristup tehnologiji i obrazovanju potrebnom za njezinu uporabu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The critique of the concentration of AI in a few companies aligns well with Catholic teaching: Church documents warn against monopolies, inequality, and the concentration of economic and political influence. The proposal that every household have its own "sovereign" AI may be one possible answer, but it is not in itself a prescribed Catholic requirement nor is it an adequate solution to the broader issues of access, accountability, and the common good.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic principle of subsidiarity requires that communities be able to participate in decisions and rectify them, rather than merely supervising after the fact standards that others have already determined. That principle supports decentralization where it strengthens human agency, but Church teaching also emphasizes universal access to technology and the education necessary for its use.
concerns_en: The claim that the Pope warns against the concentration of power and wealth is generally substantiated, but the sources speak of the broader problem of monopolization and the unequal distribution of influence, and not necessarily of that exact phrasing.
Local AI in every household is presented as a proposal, not as explicit Church teaching; in itself it does not guarantee just access or responsible use.

sections.subtitle_en: Sovereign AI in every household as an answer to centralization
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders speaks about the Pope's warning regarding the concentration of power and the idea of household sovereign AI
sections.content_en:
Kim announces the final round of questions among the participants and jokingly warns Sanders that he might interrupt him if he talks too much. Then he asks the question: what is the Catholic perspective on the fact that AI, due to the enormous required capital, is **centralized in a few large companies**?

**Matthew Harvey Sanders** responds that the Pope has given a rather clear direction. He warned that the current centralization leads to a **concentration of power**, in which a handful of people make decisions concerning all of humanity. Sanders sees this as an existential threat to freedom and human agency. The Pope, he believes, went as far as he could. History shows that this is not good, and the worst thing would be to go with the flow as if everything were inevitable.

It is interesting that even the lab heads themselves, according to his belief, do not want this. They had to raise so much money that they became dependent on economic interests and, as he says, want to free themselves from shareholders. As an example, he cites **Demis Hassabis** and others who are seeking regulation. He claims that shareholders certainly are not asking for that, but rather that the lab heads personally consider it necessary because they have children and care about the world in which they will grow up.

Sanders's answer is **sovereign AI at the household level**. He sets out a series of practical steps:

- **Accessible computing power.** Labs are buying it up years in advance. The **DGX Spark** device by the company **Nvidia** was supposed to, he says, cost around 3,500 dollars, and now it is around seven thousand and the price is rising.
- **Pressure on elected officials**, so they know that citizens care whether they can run AI themselves. Not every question, especially a sensitive one, should end up in a big lab. People should have the right to their own computing power, models, and energy for them at home.
- **Small models are sufficient.** An average small model today, in an appropriate environment, can solve **90 to 95 percent** of questions and tasks. Why then pay a lab, he asks, if at home you only pay for electricity?
- **A concrete proposal for politics.** The government could ask **Jensen Huang** from Nvidia to **sell 20 percent of computing power to consumers**, rather than all of it to big labs. Sanders believes that Huang, who according to his words just bought Hugging Face and is investing in Poolside, would support such a vision. However, he could not propose that to shareholders on his own.

Sanders considers such a model of AI to be exceptionally aligned with the **principle of subsidiarity** and the teaching of the Church, as a way to resist centralization.

sections.subtitle: Odluke što bliže ljudima i kineski recept protiv otpuštanja
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders objašnjava supsidijarnost i kritizira kineski model zabrane otpuštanja
sections.content:
Louis Kim izravno pita: „Ne vjerujete centralizaciji moći?” Sanders odgovara kratko: „Ne, nimalo.” Kim napominje da je takvo nepovjerenje duboko ukorijenjeno u katoličkoj intelektualnoj tradiciji i moli ga da slušateljima pojasni **supsidijarnost**.

Sanders objašnjava: ako se nešto može učiniti na nižoj razini, tamo bi se i trebalo učiniti, jer odluke trebaju biti **što bliže ljudima**. Što su udaljenije od ljudi, veća je vjerojatnost da će se stvari raspasti. To svi instinktivno znamo, kaže, i to je jedan od razloga zašto ne vjerujemo političarima. Kim dodaje da postoji ljudski grijeh te da su očevi utemeljitelji sustav uzajamnih provjera i ravnoteže vlasti gradili na grčkoj filozofiji i **Polibiju**, na transparentnosti i raspodjeli moći.

Sanders zatim spominje Kinu. Ako se nastavi kretati prema centralizaciji, upozorava, nekolicina ljudi imat će golem utjecaj na politički sustav zbog moći i bogatstva kojim raspolaže. **Kineski odgovor na krizu zapošljavanja** je, prema njegovim riječima, zabrana otpuštanja. Sanders ga ne smatra rješenjem: tjerati čovjeka da ostane na poslu koji vjerojatno ni ne voli ne znači ići naprijed.

Cilj bi, smatra, trebao biti drugačiji. Svatko bi trebao moći koristiti AI da ostvari svoje snove, otkrije tko je i ispuni svoju svrhu. **Oslobađanje ljudi od mukotrpnog rada** nije loše, ali treba osigurati da ih postojeći ekonomski sustav pritom ne uništi.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da se odluke donose što bliže ljudima uglavnom odgovara supsidijarnosti, ali je načelo nepotpuno ako se shvati kao opće nepovjerenje prema svakoj centralnoj vlasti: viša razina može imati dužnost pomoći kada niže razine ne mogu ostvariti nužne ciljeve. Spominjanje kineskih ograničenja otpuštanja zbog AI-ja samo po sebi nije ni potvrda ni osuda takve politike; dostupni izvori ne potvrđuju tu činjeničnu tvrdnju niti određuju da je upravo takva mjera obvezna.
concerns: Supsidijarnost nije isto što i zahtjev da se baš svaka odluka donosi lokalno: uključuje suradnju razina vlasti te odgovarajuću pomoć viših razina kada je potrebna.
Za tvrdnju o kineskoj politici nema izravne potvrde u dostupnim izvorima; katolički nauk podržava zaštitu dostojanstva rada i zaposlenja, ali ne propisuje određenu kinesku regulatornu mjeru.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk upozorava da se AI ne smije koristiti tako da korist pripadne nekolicini, a mnogi budu osiromašeni ili da se ljudski rad sustavno žrtvuje radi profita. Istodobno, cilj nije automatski spriječiti svaku tehnološku promjenu, nego usmjeriti je tako da AI podupire, a ne nepotrebno zamjenjuje ljudski rad te da zaštita radnika služi dostojanstvu osobe i općem dobru.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that decisions should be made as close to the people as possible generally corresponds to subsidiarity, but the principle is incomplete if understood as a general distrust toward all central authority: a higher level may have a duty to assist when lower levels cannot achieve necessary goals. The mention of Chinese restrictions on layoffs due to AI is in itself neither an endorsement nor a condemnation of such a policy; available sources do not confirm this factual claim, nor do they determine that precisely such a measure is mandatory.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching warns that AI must not be used in such a way that the benefit falls to a few while many are impoverished, or that human work is systematically sacrificed for profit. At the same time, the goal is not to automatically prevent all technological change, but to direct it so that AI supports, rather than unnecessarily replaces, human work and that the protection of workers serves the dignity of the person and the common good.
concerns_en: Subsidiarity is not the same as a demand that literally every decision be made locally: it includes cooperation between levels of authority and appropriate assistance from higher levels when needed.

There is no direct confirmation in available sources for the claim about Chinese policy; Catholic teaching supports the protection of the dignity of work and employment, but does not prescribe a specific Chinese regulatory measure.

sections.subtitle_en: Decisions as close to the people as possible and the Chinese recipe against layoffs
sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders explains subsidiarity and criticizes the Chinese model of banning layoffs
sections.content_en:
Louis Kim directly asks: "You don't trust centralization of power?" Sanders answers briefly: "No, not at all." Kim notes that such distrust is deeply rooted in the Catholic intellectual tradition and asks him to clarify **subsidiarity** for the listeners.

Sanders explains: if something can be done at a lower level, it should be done there, because decisions should be **as close to the people as possible**. The further they are from the people, the greater the likelihood that things will fall apart. We all instinctively know this, he says, and that is one of the reasons why we do not trust politicians. Kim adds that human sin exists and that the founding fathers built the system of checks and balances on Greek philosophy and **Polybius**, on transparency and the distribution of power.

Sanders then mentions China. If it continues to move toward centralization, he warns, a few people will have immense influence on the political system because of the power and wealth at their disposal. **The Chinese response to the employment crisis** is, according to his words, a ban on layoffs. Sanders does not consider it a solution: forcing a person to stay at a job they probably do not even like does not mean moving forward.

The goal, he believes, should be different. Everyone should be able to use AI to realize their dreams, discover who they are, and fulfill their purpose. **Freeing people from drudgery** is not bad, but it must be ensured that the existing economic system does not destroy them in the process.

sections.subtitle: Više slobodnog vremena ili još više posla?
sections.screenshot_description: Taylor Black razmišlja o tome što znači katolička tvrtka i zašto radimo 40 sati tjedno
sections.content:
U završnom krugu svaki sudionik postavlja pitanje nekom od ostalih. **Vincent Higgins** pita **Taylora Blacka** što će se dogoditi s viškom slobodnog vremena koje AI obećava. Hoće li ga ljudi provoditi s obiteljima ili će se dogoditi suprotno, pa će zbog optimizacije dobiti još više posla?

Black smatra da to ovisi o **naravi tvrtke**. Zato hvali konferencije poput Ascenta, koje govore o izgradnji tvrtke s katoličkim karakterom. Nedavno je, priča, sudjelovao na forumu na kojem se raspravljalo što znači biti katolička tvrtka. U strogom smislu, napominje, katolički može biti samo čovjek. No sam pojam otvara pitanja: zašto smo **proizvoljno odabrali radni tjedan od 40 sati**? Ima li direktor tvrtke vrjedniji posao od **roditelja koji ostaje kod kuće s djecom**? Black nije siguran da je tako u katoličkom pogledu na svijet.

Tehnološki potres katoličkim graditeljima pruža priliku da **iznova osmisle tvrtku i narav rada** i da vrijednosti tvrtke usklade sa svojom teologijom i filozofijom. Navodi primjere eksperimenata koji i dalje imaju ekonomskog smisla:

- **bonus od 5.000 dolara za sklapanje braka**,
- **slobodni svi zapovijedani blagdani**,
- i slične mjere koje unose katolički karakter.

Sve to ide protiv toga da se zatečeno stanje prihvati zdravo za gotovo, jer je ono, kaže, nastalo razumno, ali povijesno nasumično, kroz sukob mnogih interesa.

magisterium.assessment: Uglavnom je usklađeno: odlomak prepoznaje da koristi automatizacije treba prosuđivati prema tome služi li tvrtka čovjeku, obitelji i dostojanstvu rada, a ne samo učinkovitosti. Ipak, prikaz ostaje na razini kulture tvrtke i ne spominje zaštitu radnika ni pravednu raspodjelu koristi od AI-ja.
concerns: Slobodno vrijeme i obiteljski život prepoznati su kao važno mjerilo, ali nisu izričito razmotrene odgovornosti poslodavaca za zaštitu radnog dostojanstva, pravedne plaće i sigurnost zaposlenja.
Naglasak na kulturi pojedine tvrtke mogao bi ostaviti dojam da je dovoljno oslanjanje na dobru volju poslodavca; katolički socijalni nauk također ističe zaštitu radnika i zajedničko dobro.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk ne odbacuje AI koji smanjuje naporan, ponavljajući ili opasan rad, ali zahtijeva da se tehnološki napredak ne pretvori u zamjenu ljudi radi veće dobiti ili u nametanje još većeg opterećenja radnicima. Ušteđeno vrijeme i produktivnost trebalo bi prosuđivati prema tome jačaju li ljudsko dostojanstvo, obiteljski život i zajedničko dobro.

sections.subtitle_en: More Free Time or Even More Work?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Taylor Black reflects on what a Catholic company means and why we work 40 hours a week
sections.content_en:
In the final round, each participant asks a question to one of the others. **Vincent Higgins** asks **Taylor Black** what will happen to the surplus of free time that AI promises. Will people spend it with their families, or will the opposite happen, so that due to optimization they will receive even more work?

Black believes that this depends on the **nature of the company**. That is why he praises conferences like Ascent, which talk about building a company with a Catholic character. Recently, he recounts, he participated in a forum where what it means to be a Catholic company was discussed. In a strict sense, he notes, only a human being can be Catholic. But the concept itself opens up questions: why did we **arbitrarily choose a 40-hour work week**? Does a company CEO have a more valuable job than a **parent who stays at home with children**? Black is not sure that this is the case in the Catholic worldview.

The technological earthquake provides Catholic builders with an opportunity to **reimagine the company and the nature of work** and to align the company's values with their theology and philosophy. He cites examples of experiments that still make economic sense:

- **a 5,000-dollar bonus for entering into marriage**,
- **all holy days of obligation off**,
- and similar measures that introduce a Catholic character.

All of this goes against taking the status quo for granted, because it was created, he says, reasonably, but historically randomly, through the conflict of many interests.

sections.subtitle: Fizički AI: modeli na rubu mreže i kamere u slušalicama
sections.screenshot_description: Vincent Higgins objašnjava edge computing i upozorava na privatnost uređaja koji snimaju svakodnevicu
sections.content:
**Taylor Black** zatim pita **Vincenta Higginsa**. Čudi ga što se tako malo govori o mogućnostima AI-ja u istraživanju i u izgrađenom fizičkom svijetu, pa traži da iz industrijske perspektive objasni što vidi.

Higgins objašnjava da je **fizički AI** umjetna inteligencija koja nas doseže u stvarnom svijetu, a ne samo na ekranu. Njegova tvrtka gradi **hardver za edge computing**: model ostaje lokalno na uređaju, pa se dio odluka donosi bez oblaka. Ako se izgubi internetska veza, AI je i dalje dostupan, što je ključno na terenu, gdje se veza često gubi.

No razvoj fizičkog AI-ja ima i tamniju stranu. Razvijaju se mikrofoni i kamere koji, kako kaže, na pomalo zastrašujući način bilježe sve više našeg svijeta. Vidio je dizajne **slušalica s ugrađenim kamerama** koje razumiju kontekst: kad uđete u trgovinu, znaju što birate i kod koje ste police. Time se otvara **pitanje privatnosti**. Kad fizički AI dotakne svaki trenutak dana, upozorava Higgins, nalazimo se na skliskom terenu koji moramo pažljivo pratiti.

magisterium.assessment: Opis fizičkog AI-ja i lokalne obrade na rubu mreže sam po sebi nije u suprotnosti s katoličkim naukom; primjena može služiti sigurnosti i dobrobiti radnika. Ipak, kamere u zaštitnoj opremi otvaraju pitanja privatnosti i nadzora koja odlomak ne razmatra.
concerns: Nije navedeno kako se prikupljaju, pohranjuju i koriste snimke niti tko im može pristupiti.
Lokalna obrada ne jamči sama po sebi zaštitu privatnosti ili razmjernu upotrebu nadzornih podataka.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko vrednovanje takve tehnologije ovisi o njezinoj svrsi i načinu uporabe: oni trebaju poštovati ljudsko dostojanstvo i promicati opće dobro. Pravo na privatnost štiti dostojanstvo i slobodu osobe, a nadzor radi iskorištavanja ili neopravdanog ograničavanja slobode nije opravdan.

sections.subtitle_en: Physical AI: models at the edge of the network and cameras in headphones
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vincent Higgins explains edge computing and warns about the privacy of devices that record everyday life
sections.content_en:
**Taylor Black** then asks **Vincent Higgins**. He is surprised that there is so little talk about the possibilities of AI in research and in the built physical world, so he asks him to explain what he sees from an industrial perspective.

Higgins explains that **physical AI** is artificial intelligence that reaches us in the real world, and not only on a screen. His company builds **hardware for edge computing**: the model remains locally on the device, so part of the decisions is made without the cloud. If the internet connection is lost, AI is still available, which is crucial in the field, where the connection is often lost.

However, the development of physical AI also has a darker side. Microphones and cameras are being developed that, as he says, in a somewhat frightening way record more and more of our world. He has seen designs of **headphones with built-in cameras** that understand context: when you enter a store, they know what you are choosing and at which shelf you are. This opens **the question of privacy**. When physical AI touches every moment of the day, Higgins warns, we find ourselves on slippery ground that we must monitor carefully.

sections.subtitle: Robotski psi u naftnoj industriji, humanoidi u našim domovima
sections.screenshot_description: Vincent Higgins govori o robotskim psima u inspekcijama i dolasku humanoidnih robota u kućanstva
sections.content:
**Matthew Harvey Sanders** ima dva pitanja za Higginsa. Prvo se tiče velikih laboratorija. Kako se približavaju AGI-ju, njihovi su modeli sve općenitiji, a Sanders je bio iznenađen koliko je Astra sposobna kada je utjelovljena u robotici. Brine li Higginsa da će laboratoriji jednostavno ući u hardver i preuzeti i industrijske radnike? U čemu je onda konkurentska prednost tvrtki koje razvijaju uređaje i industrija s mnogo iskustva i podataka u odnosu na laboratorij poput **OpenAI-ja**?

Higgins odgovara primjerom iz **naftne i plinske industrije**, gdje **robotski psi** već zamjenjuju ljude u inspekcijama. Mogu raditi gotovo sve što i čovjek: fotografirati i skenirati, i to u opasnim zonama u kojima ljudi ne bi trebali biti. To smatra vrlo pozitivnim.

Drugačije je kada se ista tehnologija stavi u **humanoidnog robota u domu**, koji šeće psa i kuha obroke. Tu postoje sigurnosna pitanja. Higgins procjenjuje da to nije pitanje sljedećih dvadeset, nego **sljedećih pet godina**. Humanoidi će isprva biti skupi, ali ništa ih, smatra, ne sprječava da uskoro uđu u domove. Zato poziva na promišljenost. Robot je u biti **utjelovljeni AI**: napredni modeli ugrađeni u glavu robota. To što su **multimodalni** i izvorno razumiju video i zvuk čini ih vrlo učinkovitima u opažanju okoline i snalaženju u njoj.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak otvara legitimno pitanje može li robotizacija zamijeniti ljudske radnike, ali ga postavlja kao zabrinutost i ne iznosi izričit sud o tome je li takav razvoj opravdan. Zato je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom, uz neizrečenu potrebu da se razmotre dostojanstvo rada i posljedice za radnike.
concerns: Mogućnost da roboti preuzmu poslove nije sama po sebi dovoljna za zaključak o moralnoj neprihvatljivosti: važno je služi li tehnologija ljudima ili sustavno žrtvuje zaposlenost radi profita.
Odlomak ne razjašnjava hoće li roboti pomagati ljudima u opasnim ili napornim poslovima, nadopunjavati njihov rad ili ih zamjenjivati.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk ne odbacuje tehnološki napredak, ali traži da on bude usmjeren prema ljudskom dobru. Umjetna inteligencija i robotika trebale bi pomagati, a ne jednostavno zamjenjivati ljudski rad; zaštita radnih mjesta i dostojanstva radnika važni su uz razmatranje mogućih koristi automatizacije.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage raises the legitimate question of whether robotization can replace human workers, but presents it as a concern and does not express an explicit judgment on whether such a development is justified. Therefore, it is largely aligned with Catholic teaching, with an unexpressed need to consider the dignity of work and the consequences for workers.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching does not reject technological progress, but demands that it be directed toward the human good. Artificial intelligence and robotics should assist, rather than simply replace, human labor; the protection of jobs and the dignity of workers are important alongside considering the potential benefits of automation.
concerns_en: The possibility of robots taking over jobs is not in itself sufficient for a conclusion of moral unacceptability: it is important whether technology serves humans or systematically sacrifices employment for profit.
The passage does not clarify whether robots will assist humans in hazardous or strenuous jobs, supplement their labor, or replace them.

sections.subtitle_en: Robotic dogs in the oil industry, humanoids in our homes
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vincent Higgins speaks about robotic dogs in inspections and the arrival of humanoid robots into households
sections.content_en:
**Matthew Harvey Sanders** has two questions for Higgins. The first concerns the large labs. As they approach AGI, their models are increasingly general, and Sanders was surprised by how capable Astra is when embodied in robotics. Does it worry Higgins that labs will simply enter hardware and take over industrial workers as well? What then is the competitive advantage of companies developing devices and industries with a lot of experience and data compared to a lab like **OpenAI**?

Higgins answers with an example from the **oil and gas industry**, where **robotic dogs** are already replacing humans in inspections. They can do almost everything a human does: take photos and scan, and that in hazardous zones where humans should not be. He considers this very positive.

It is different when the same technology is put into a **humanoid robot in the home**, which walks the dog and cooks meals. There safety issues exist. Higgins estimates that this is not a question of the next twenty, but of the **next five years**. Humanoids will initially be expensive, but nothing, he believes, prevents them from entering homes soon. Therefore, he calls for thoughtfulness. A robot is essentially **embodied AI**: advanced models built into the robot's head. The fact that they are **multimodal** and natively understand video and sound makes them very effective in perceiving the environment and navigating in it.

sections.subtitle: Tko je vlasnik vaših zdravstvenih podataka?
sections.screenshot_description: Matthew Harvey Sanders upozorava da biometrijski podaci s pametnih satova završavaju kod velikih kompanija
sections.content:
Sandersovo drugo pitanje odnosi se na zdravlje. Iznenađuje ga, kaže, **koliko se malo AI razvija u području preventivne medicine**. Gotovo svi nose pametne satove i narukvice koji prate biometriju, ali ti podaci uglavnom odlaze velikim kompanijama koje proizvode uređaje poput **Fitbita** i **Apple Watcha**. I tu vidi kretanje prema **centralizaciji osobnih medicinskih podataka**, uz vrlo malo suverenosti pojedinca. Ne zna mnogo tvrtki koje pokušavaju ljudima dati veću kontrolu nad vlastitim podacima, a područjem i dalje dominiraju veliki tehnološki igrači. Spominje i sugovornikovo ranije iskustvo rada na osobnom AI-ju u HP-u i pita vidi li ikakve znakove nade.

Prema transkriptu, odgovara voditelj **Louis Kim**. Nada je, kaže, u skladu s onim što je Sanders opisao o **lokalnom AI-ju**. Obrada svih biometrijskih podataka i predviđanje ishoda već je unutar dosega današnje računalne snage. Ključno je pitanje **gdje se ti podaci pohranjuju**. Kim, koji prati zbivanja u zdravstvu, slaže se da u tom smjeru nije vidio mnogo pomaka. Sanders zaključuje pozivom slušateljima: tu leži velika prilika, pa neka se netko prihvati posla.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer upozorava na koncentraciju osobnih zdravstvenih podataka i manjak nadzora pojedinca, što se tiče privatnosti i ljudskog dostojanstva. Ipak, iznesene tvrdnje o tome kamo podaci s pametnih satova odlaze te o malom opsegu preventivnih AI alata ne mogu se potvrditi dostupnim crkvenim izvorima, a „suverenost” nad podacima ne treba bez dodatnog obrazloženja poistovjetiti s apsolutnim pravom vlasništva.
concerns: Nije navedeno prikupljaju li se podaci uz informirani pristanak ni kako se štite, koriste ili dijele; to su važna etička pitanja, ali nisu razjašnjena u odlomku.
Tvrdnje o razvoju preventivne medicine i prijenosu biometrijskih podataka iznesene su kao činjenice, no dostupni izvori ih ne potvrđuju.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva smatra da privatnost nije puka povlastica nego pravo koje štiti dostojanstvo, unutarnji život i slobodu osobe; digitalni podaci mogu omogućiti moć nad pojedincem. Zato se podaci i umjetna inteligencija trebaju uređivati tako da štite osobu i opće dobro, uz transparentnost i odgovornost, a ne da nadzor ili koncentracija koristi idu na štetu mnogih.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it warns about the concentration of personal health data and the lack of individual control, which pertains to privacy and human dignity. However, the claims made about where data from smartwatches goes and about the small scope of preventive AI tools cannot be confirmed by available Church sources, and "sovereignty" over data should not be equated with an absolute property right without further explanation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church considers that privacy is not a mere privilege but a right that protects the dignity, inner life, and freedom of the person; digital data can enable power over the individual. Therefore, data and artificial intelligence should be regulated in such a way as to protect the person and the common good, with transparency and accountability, rather than allowing surveillance or the concentration of benefits to occur at the expense of many.
concerns_en: It is not stated whether data is collected with informed consent, nor how it is protected, used, or shared; these are important ethical questions, but they are not clarified in the passage.
The claims about the development of preventive medicine and the transfer of biometric data are presented as facts, but available sources do not confirm them.

sections.screenshot_description_en: Matthew Harvey Sanders warns that biometric data from smartwatches ends up with big companies
sections.content_en:
Sanders' second question relates to health. It surprises him, he says, **how little AI is developing in the field of preventive medicine**. Almost everyone wears smartwatches and wristbands that track biometrics, but that data mostly goes to the big companies that produce devices like **Fitbit** and the **Apple Watch**. And here he sees a movement toward the **centralization of personal medical data**, with very little individual sovereignty. He does not know many companies trying to give people greater control over their own data, and the field continues to be dominated by big tech players. He also mentions the interlocutor's earlier experience working on personal AI at HP and asks whether he sees any signs of hope.

According to the transcript, host **Louis Kim** responds. The hope, he says, is in line with what Sanders described regarding **local AI**. Processing all biometric data and predicting outcomes is already within the reach of today's computing power. The key question is **where this data is stored**. Kim, who follows developments in healthcare, agrees that he has not seen much progress in that direction. Sanders concludes with an appeal to the listeners: a great opportunity lies here, so let someone get to work.

sections.subtitle: Posljednja ljudska uloga: od hospicija do „Aliena” i „Heata”
sections.screenshot_description: Louis Kim govori o radu u hospiciju i pitanju posljednje ljudske uloge u zdravstvu
sections.content:
Kim zatim dijeli temu koja mu je osobno najbliža. Napustio je korporativni svijet velike tehnologije kako bi radio u **hospicijskoj i palijativnoj skrbi**. Zaokuplja ga pitanje: ako AI postane bolji u dijagnostici i ako se gotovo sve u zdravstvu može bolje obaviti uz AI, **koja je posljednja ljudska uloga?** Iz ontoloških i teoloških razloga, kaže, možda ćete htjeti ljudskog kapelana, iako je čovjek mrzovoljniji i manje prisutan od robota-kapelana koji je savršeno pažljiv. To naziva vrlo dobrim katoličkim problemom.

Sanders se prisjeća prvog filma **„Alien”**. Dok je čudovište na brodu, kapetan pita računalo kakve su im šanse za preživljavanje, a stroj odgovara da nemaju nikakve. Ta poruka, hladna poput natpisa „napustite svaku nadu”, pojavljuje se na ekranu i lik je samo čita. Sanders zamišlja kako bi ista vijest djelovala da ju je izgovorio čovjek koji te gleda u oči i dijeli tvoju sudbinu. Tako razmišlja i o hospiciju. Nada se da liječnici koriste AI, jer je dijagnostika s njim bolja. No ne želi ležati u krevetu dok tablet pokraj njega ne zazvoni s viješću da su mu šanse pale s deset na nula. Volio bi da se čovjeku kaže: tu vijest moraš prenijeti ti.

Kim objašnjava da ga upravo zato privlače **književnost i film**: mogu prenijeti ljudsko suosjećanje u situacijama u kojima ono nema logike. Jedna od njegovih najdražih filmskih scena je završetak filma **„Heat”**. Pacinov lik u zračnoj luci ustrijeli De Nirova pljačkaša banaka. Dok De Niro umire, pruža ruku, a Pacino je prihvaća, u potpunoj tišini, iako su bili smrtni neprijatelji. To je, kaže Kim, potpuno nelogičan i duboko ljudski čin. Kako algoritam ili robot programirati da to učini? To je, zaključuje, **otajstvo**.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je vrlo usklađen s katoličkim naukom: AI može pomagati u zdravstvu, ali ne bi smio zamijeniti ljudski odnos s bolesnikom, a prisutnost uz umirućega ima vrijednost koja se ne svodi na dijagnostiku ili liječenje. Izraz „ljudi će htjeti” ljudskog kapelana najbolje je shvatiti kao očekivanje, a ne kao jedini temelj argumenta: potreba proizlazi i iz dostojanstva osobe te kršćanskog poziva na blizinu i nadu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno učenje ističe da uporaba AI-ja koja zamjenjuje odnos pacijenta i zdravstvenog djelatnika može pojačati usamljenost i zanemariti ljudsku solidarnost. U skrbi za umiruće, ostati uz bolesnika, tješiti ga i biti mu prisutan može svjedočiti njegovoj jedinstvenoj vrijednosti i nadi; to ne znači da AI nema korisnu pomoćnu ulogu, nego da ne može preuzeti osobnu odgovornost i ljudski odnos.
